IAMC Description: Total carbon dioxide emissions captured, i.e. captured CO2 stream from bioenergy use, fossil fuel use, industrial processes, and direct air capture; should be reported as positive numbers

Fossil CO2 emissions from energy use on supply and demand side (IPCC category 1A, 1B) and from industrial processes (IPCC categories 2A, B, C, E), including emissions from international bunkers, net of negative emissions from Bioenergy with CCS (BECCS)
FRIDA Variable: Emissions.Realized CO2 emissions from Energy + Concrete.CO2 emissions
Transformation: sum of the two series (currently disabled in 2-Calculate.R pending formulation review)

IAMC Description: total Kyoto GHG emissions, including CO2, CH4, N2O and F-gases (preferably use 100-year GWPs from AR4 for aggregation of different gases; in case other GWPs have been used, please document this on the 'comments' tab)
total final energy consumption by all end-use sectors and all fuels, excluding transmission/distribution losses, including non-energy use
GDP converted to International $ using purchasing power parity (PPP)
price of carbon (for regional aggregrates the weighted price of carbon by subregion should be used)
FRIDA Variable: Government Regulations.actual tax on CO2e emissions
Transformation: multiply by 1/1.36716299937247 = 0.731445 (2021 -> 2010 USD); protocol unit string kept although value is a per-tonne price
sum of the Primary Energy|Coal/Oil/Gas (already primary) + |Biomass/Nuclear/Solar/Wind (input-equivalent) components; not derived from a single FRIDA variable

IAMC Description: primary energy consumption of purpose-grown bioenergy crops, crop and forestry residue bioenergy, municipal solid waste bioenergy, traditional biomass
FRIDA Variable: Bio fuel energy.bio fuel secondary energy output + Fossil Energy.conversion efficiency of fossil fuels to secondary fossil energy
Transformation: multiply by 0.0036 (TWh -> EJ) then divide by FRIDA's conversion efficiency of fossil fuels to secondary fossil energy (input-equivalent method); efficiency joined per scenario/run/year

FRIDA Variable: Fossil energy coal.Primary Fossil Energy FUEL
Transformation: multiply by 1000 (ZJ -> EJ; factor unverified against real output)

FRIDA Variable: Fossil energy gas.Primary Fossil Energy FUEL
Transformation: multiply by 1000 (ZJ -> EJ; factor unverified against real output)

IAMC Description: conventional & unconventional oil primary energy consumption
FRIDA Variable: Fossil energy oil.Primary Fossil Energy FUEL
Transformation: multiply by 1000 (ZJ -> EJ; factor unverified against real output)

IAMC Description: nuclear primary energy consumption (direct equivalent, includes electricity, heat and hydrogen production from nuclear energy)
FRIDA Variable: nuclear energy.nuclear energy output + Fossil Energy.conversion efficiency of fossil fuels to secondary fossil energy
Transformation: multiply by 0.0036 (TWh -> EJ) then divide by FRIDA's conversion efficiency of fossil fuels to secondary fossil energy (input-equivalent method); efficiency joined per scenario/run/year

FRIDA Variable: Solar energy.Solar Energy Output + Fossil Energy.conversion efficiency of fossil fuels to secondary fossil energy
Transformation: multiply by 0.0036 (TWh -> EJ) then divide by FRIDA's conversion efficiency of fossil fuels to secondary fossil energy (input-equivalent method); efficiency joined per scenario/run/year

FRIDA Variable: Wind energy.Wind energy output + Fossil Energy.conversion efficiency of fossil fuels to secondary fossil energy
Transformation: multiply by 0.0036 (TWh -> EJ) then divide by FRIDA's conversion efficiency of fossil fuels to secondary fossil energy (input-equivalent method); efficiency joined per scenario/run/year

IAMC Variable: Policy Cost|Additional Total Energy System Cost
Transformation: (scenario minus baseline) then multiply by 1/1.36716299937247 = 0.731445 (2021 -> 2010 USD); positive when policy costs more; baseline = Baseline_Scenario in 0-Main.R; investment flow used as proxy for total cost

IAMC Description: consumption loss in a policy scenario compared to the corresponding baseline (losses should be reported as positive numbers)
FRIDA Variable: Circular Flow.real private consumption 2021c$ (scenario and baseline)
Transformation: (baseline minus scenario) then multiply by 1/1.36716299937247 = 0.731445 (2021 -> 2010 USD); losses positive; baseline = Baseline_Scenario in 0-Main.R
